front.title: Boundary Jurisdiction Architecture for Agentic and Delegated Systems

abstract.t:
This document describes a protocol-neutral architecture for separating possession of capability from jurisdiction over consequential authority boundaries. It models authority as reachability in a time-indexed capability graph, defines commitment boundaries and independently controlled revocation cuts, and specifies fail-closed semantics for evidence, authorization, delegation, and revocation closure.
